title: Garcia's Paean: Easy Peasy
description: Garcia seems to be sweating over something at the blacksmith...

mainQuestExcel.title: Garcia's Paean: Easy Peasy
mainQuestExcel.description: Garcia seems to be sweating over something at the blacksmith...

dialogs.text: My hands... Ugh! They're both numb...
Sir, you still need to do accounts for Ms. Kaia later. Please don't exhaust yourself.
Not right now, Lutong! I—I am well aware!
Of course, if you can't make it, I will stand in for you.
No! I will do that myself. I am just... I just need to... forge a couple more gears...
Okay, I give up, I just can't continue anymore...
What are you doing now...
Oh, it's you, Traveler... Ouch... My hands...
Well, here's the situation. Mr. Ahangar is also otherwise engaged, and so it is not possible to constantly commission him to make the parts I need...
Moreover, the parts he makes are often ever so slightly different from those that I picture in my mind.
So, to ensure the reliability of these parts, I asked Mr. Ahangar to teach me some forging skills and decided to forge the parts on my own.
Fortunately, I have acquired relevant experience in Fontaine... But some of the techniques Mr. Ahangar spoke of were just so hard to remember. Ouch...
Traveler, could you please ask Mr. Ahangar about his forging techniques? I really need some rest...
Have a good rest here, Mr. Garcia.
Thank you for being willing to help. Ugh... My hands...
Who is Kaia?
A business partner! A... um... very talented and... rich business partner!
We have signed a long-term accounting contract with her! And that is why I've been meeting her often, as I'm certain Lutong can attest to.
That is perfectly right, sir.
S—So that's how things stand... Traveler, do help us find Mr. Ahangar as soon as possible. I shall be waiting here.
What on earth does this guy have in his mind...
I told you! Just wait a sec... Huh. It's you.
I'm here to ask some questions on Mr. Garcia's behalf.
So he actually went and did that himself... What a weirdo.
I've been a blacksmith for a great many years. This is the first time I've encountered someone with such strict requirements.
He even brings a ruler to measure the seam between iron tubes, and the distance between threads.
I just can't put up with him, so I told him to do it himself... And you know what? He actually came the next day and asked me to teach him some forging skills.
Really, there's nothing I can do about him, so I let him be. As long as he pays for the materials, I'll let him use whatever tools he wants.
*sigh* I've no idea what this guy has in mind...
He's making a wondrous machine.
Eh, it's probably something strange, whatever it is. You're here to ask about forging skills, right? To be honest, I have nothing much to teach regarding gear forging...
I have noticed something about the gears he wants, though. They all have sharp edges but are concave in the middle...
Molds are not enough for such specially-shaped gears, so he has to reshape the gears afterward.
I've taught him about the techniques in detail. You just need to tell him...
First, <color=#00E1FFFF>remember to add enough fuel to really heat up the fire</color> when putting it into the furnace for the second time.
Then, when you take it out to process it, <color=#00E1FFFF>hammer it from the inside out</color>.
Did you get all that? Alright, go back and tell him if you did.
What a weirdo...
He's making a weird machine.
Mr. Garcia's hands went numb from all that forging, and he needs rest.
Sir, I humbly suggest that we might have to... change our approach.
Change our approach?
Perhaps we might make something less complicated but equally intricate.
I believe that with your talents, making machines of this sort should be...
My dear Lutong, we have spoken of this matter before. You know my answer... but I will always respect your choices.
Perhaps we should instead discuss where you shall have dinner with Ms. Kaia next, sir.
Ah, thank you, Lutong.
My pleasure, sir. Our contract has not ended yet.
Lutong! This gear is ready for demolding! Come help me!
Traveler, you're back. So, Mr. Ahangar has taught you his tricks, I trust?
Tell me then, how should I process this gear?
When sending the parts into the furnace again, remember to add more fuel.
When sending the parts into the furnace again, don't add more fuel.
When sending the parts into the furnace again, remember to add less fuel.
Garcia begins his work...
Alright, this gear has been heated up... What next?
Hammer it in the middle and work your way out to the edges.
Hammer it around the edges and work your way into the middle.
Hammer it in the middle real hard.
Garcia begins his work...
Um... The gear doesn't quite... look right.
It's okay, we'll start over... Traveler, what should I take into consideration?
Garcia begins his work...
Aha! Success! This gear looks mighty fine, if I should say so myself!
The spacing between its teeth... Thickness... Size... Ah, I must fetch a ruler...
It's best that we leave Mr. Garcia to his measurements. Traveler, here is your payment. Please take it.
Are you still... cautiously pessimistic?
Yes, that's how I have always been.
Mr. Garcia and I have been wandering in front of a giant mountain for some time now, and we have only just removed a tiny stone from the foot of this mountain.
We have, in truth, not yet found a way up.
Hopefully, Mr. Garcia's talents will lead us to the right path...
Or I will have to tell myself that "when your path is blocked by a mountain, there will be a way through."
Do you have other questions for me?
Has Garcia been here for long?
Quite some time, I would say. This guy is even more passionate than some of my apprentices.
But he just doesn't look like someone who wants to make a living as a blacksmith...
Did anyone visit them other than me?
Hmm... There is a woman who visits him quite often, and she comes bringing lots of things.
He has told me that the woman is named Kaia... Or something like that.
I don't get it. These people look nothing like blacksmiths, so why do they hang around in my smithy...

questNarration.text: (The gear's dimensions should be... Kaia helped me record them last time... Ugh! What is WRONG with me!?)
(Maybe I should go talk to Ms. Kaia...)
